description.sr:
Rest parametar skuplja argumente u niz. U `function f(...nums)` tri tačke ispred imena znače: svi argumenti poziva idu u jedan pravi niz `nums`. Poziv `f(1, 2, 3)` daje `nums = [1, 2, 3]`, a poziv `f()` daje `nums = []`. Zato funkcija može da primi koliko god argumenata.

Napiši funkciju `sumAll(...nums)` koja vraća zbir svih argumenata.

Svaki argument je broj. Funkcija vraća jedan broj.

Pravila:
- bez argumenata zbir je `0`
- radi i sa jednim argumentom i sa negativnim brojevima

Primeri:
- `sumAll(1, 2, 3)` → `6`
- `sumAll(10)` → `10`
- `sumAll(5, -2, -3)` → `0`
- `sumAll(-4, -6)` → `-10`
- `sumAll()` → `0`, jer nema šta da se sabere
description.en:
A rest parameter collects arguments into an array. In `function f(...nums)` the three dots in front of the name mean: all arguments of the call go into one real array `nums`. The call `f(1, 2, 3)` gives `nums = [1, 2, 3]`, and the call `f()` gives `nums = []`. That is why the function can accept any number of arguments.

Write a function `sumAll(...nums)` that returns the sum of all arguments.

Every argument is a number. The function returns one number.

Rules:
- with no arguments the sum is `0`
- it works with a single argument and with negative numbers

Examples:
- `sumAll(1, 2, 3)` → `6`
- `sumAll(10)` → `10`
- `sumAll(5, -2, -3)` → `0`
- `sumAll(-4, -6)` → `-10`
- `sumAll()` → `0`, because there is nothing to add

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function sumAll` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(...nums)` je rest parametar. Tri tačke znače: skupi sve prosleđene argumente u jedan pravi niz `nums`. Poziv `sumAll(1, 2, 3)` daje `nums = [1, 2, 3]`, a poziv `sumAll()` daje `nums = []`. Zato funkcija prima koliko god argumenata.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 7.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function sumAll` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(...nums)` is a rest parameter. The three dots mean: collect all passed arguments into one real array `nums`. The call `sumAll(1, 2, 3)` gives `nums = [1, 2, 3]`, and the call `sumAll()` gives `nums = []`. That is why the function accepts any number of arguments.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 7 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Pravimo zbir koji počinje od nule.

- `let` jer se vrednost `total` menja u svakom krugu petlje.
- `0` je početna vrednost i neutralan element za sabiranje. Ako nema argumenata, petlja se nijednom ne izvrši i vraća se upravo `0`, kako zadatak traži.
text.en:
We create a sum that starts at zero.

- `let` because the value of `total` changes in every round of the loop.
- `0` is the starting value and the neutral element for addition. If there are no arguments, the loop does not run even once and exactly `0` is returned, as the task asks.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz sve argumente.

- `for (const n of nums)` znači: za svaki element niza `nums`, redom, uradi telo petlje. U svakom krugu `n` je jedan broj.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 5.
text.en:
We go through all the arguments.

- `for (const n of nums)` means: for every element of the array `nums`, in order, run the loop body. In every round `n` is one number.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 5.

text.sr:
Dodajemo broj na zbir.

- `total += n` je skraćeno od `total = total + n`.

```
sumAll(5, -2, -3), total na početku: 0
krug  n    total posle kruga
1     5    5
2     -2   3
3     -3   0
```
text.en:
We add the number to the sum.

- `total += n` is short for `total = total + n`.

```
sumAll(5, -2, -3), total at the start: 0
round  n    total after the round
1      5    5
2      -2   3
3      -3   0
```

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Cela obrada je u jednoj liniji.

- `nums.reduce(...)` svodi ceo niz na jednu vrednost. Prolazi kroz elemente redom i nosi sa sobom akumulator, tj. rezultat do tog trenutka.
- `(total, n) => total + n` je funkcija koju `reduce` poziva za svaki element: `total` je akumulator, `n` je tekući broj, a ono što funkcija vrati postaje novi `total`.
- `0` posle strelice je početna vrednost akumulatora. Ona je važna: kod praznog niza `reduce` bez početne vrednosti baca grešku (`TypeError`), a sa njom vraća baš tu vrednost, pa `sumAll()` daje `0`.

```
sumAll(5, -2, -3), početno total = 0
n = 5   → total = 0 + 5 = 5
n = -2  → total = 5 + (-2) = 3
n = -3  → total = 3 + (-3) = 0
rezultat: 0
```
text.en:
The whole processing is on one line.

- `nums.reduce(...)` reduces the whole array to a single value. It goes through the elements in order and carries an accumulator, i.e. the result up to that moment.
- `(total, n) => total + n` is the function `reduce` calls for every element: `total` is the accumulator, `n` is the current number, and what the function returns becomes the new `total`.
- `0` after the arrow is the starting value of the accumulator. It matters: for an empty array `reduce` without a starting value throws an error (`TypeError`), and with it returns exactly that value, so `sumAll()` gives `0`.

```
sumAll(5, -2, -3), starting total = 0
n = 5   → total = 0 + 5 = 5
n = -2  → total = 5 + (-2) = 3
n = -3  → total = 3 + (-3) = 0
result: 0
```
